title: Block or unblock a person
summary: A confirm sheet that blocks a person, or unblocks a blocked one. A blocked person's DM stays, with the composer off and a bar to unblock (ADR 0141).

mode.description: block: the user id is not in Client.ignoredUsers. unblock: it is.

phase.description: failed: bipe_app_block_error or bipe_app_unblock_error, the buttons come back.

confirm.effect: block: Client.ignoreUser. unblock: Client.unignoreUser. Then closes the sheet. Client.subscribeToIgnoredUsers updates every screen that shows the person.

notes: Opens from person-profile, from report-chat (bipe_app_report_also_block), from a chat request and from blocked-list.

Block is the Matrix ignore list (m.ignored_user_list, account data): the server stops sending the person's messages and invites to the user, on every device of the account. The user stays in shared groups.

The DM after a block (ADR 0141): the chat stays in the list. chat-timeline shows bipe_app_blocked_bar with bipe_action_unblock_person in place of the composer. Unblock in the bar opens this sheet in unblock mode.
Blocking does not tell the other person.
The confirm button of block uses the destructive style. Unblock uses the normal style.
